description: Search the source-checked claims behind the launch plan's statistics. Each result is one claim with what kind it is (standard, evidence, practitioner-consensus, our-take), how strong it is and why, when it was last checked, the sources it cites with how well each was read, and the plan steps that rely on it. Use it before quoting a number from the plan or from a marketing article. With no filters it returns the strongest claims first; with a `query` it matches words in the claim, its sources and its correction note. Read-only; no side effects.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "paywall", "Product Hunt", "dunning".

step.description: Only claims that back this plan step slug, e.g. "p3-cnv-trial".

name: search_knowledge
title: Search the evidence behind the plan
